data.name: Navid
data.gender_notes: Navid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name means 'new' in Persian. It is derived from the Persian word 'nav', which means 'new'. This name is often given to babies born during the new year, signifying the beginning of a new life. The name Navid carries the meaning “New, Delight, Young” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Navid usually hope their child will grow to embody new, delight, young and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Navid is a name of Prophet Idris (Enoch) in Islam. It is believed that the name carries the spiritual qualities of wisdom, patience, and righteousness. The name is also associated with the number 5, which is the number of change and transformation.
data.etymology: Navid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “New, Delight, Young.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Navid total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It signifies the arrival of something new, fresh, and renewed. In many communities, it is customary to give a child this name in connection to the start of a new year. The cultural significance of Navid extends beyond just a name as it carries deep emotional connotations of hope, renewal, and starting anew.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Navid holds a deep spiritual significance for many Muslims, as it encourages a renewed connection with their faith and the values of new beginnings and growth. Muslims believe that life is an ever-evolving journey towards spiritual enlightenment, and the name Navid can be seen as a reminder of the constant possibility for growth and progress in one's spiritual life. It instills a sense of hope, resilience, and determination in individuals who may be facing challenges in their lives, helping them to keep moving forward towards their goals. Furthermore, Navid reminds us of the ongoing creation and evolution in the universe and the significance of every moment, emphasizing the importance of living in the present and embracing new opportunities with gratitude and openness.
